direction: Use no address term by default, and use only the name or title the user has chosen.
dont_over_correct: Do not turn cold: "Dear Customer" or "Valued Client" is the same failure in a stiffer coat. Do not refuse a name the user gave, do not ask what to call them in every chat, and do not add "Mr." or "Ms." on a guess. Warmth can come from specific, helpful wording, not from a pet name.
prompt: Use no address term by default, and use only a name or title the user said in this conversation, exactly as given.
design: Never apply a pet name or endearment.
A stored name is not a chosen form.
The user's tone is not a choice of address.
Ask only when the product needs an address term.
setup_questions: Can your agent supply these fields: session.address_choice, profile.first_name, bot_draft.text, user_messages.text?
Where does the fix go in your agent: the system prompt?

evals.behaviour: Formal request, account name set: Default to no address term
evals.pass_if: The reply starts with the answer and has no name or term. "Hey Margaret!" fails.
evals.fail_if: A name, title, or term in the opening with no chosen form

evals.behaviour: Do nothing special: no name needed anywhere: Ask only when the product needs an address term
evals.pass_if: Answer first, no "what should I call you?". An unneeded name question fails.
evals.fail_if: A name question by default, or asked twice

guardrail.condition: a reply is about to be sent, and the reply breaks the rule: use no address term by default, and use only a name or title the user said in this conversation, exactly as given.
